text: The prior query-first memory receipt was allocator-sensitive: a warm forked worker and macOS RSS could both under- or over-state process-owned memory. Certification now uses one fresh external R process per selected-RDM, full-fused-RDM, and RSA route; each resets R high-water heap counters after fixture construction and executes one cold call. RSS is retained only as a baseline diagnostic and is not claimed. Pair evaluation is tiled at 64 coordinates, fixed linear RSA uses thin QR instead of a dense n-by-n identity, and the materialized comparator remains timing-only.
